Medical Practice Analytics

Turn Your EHR and Billing Data Into a Real-Time Dashboard

Scape connects to your practice's EHR and billing systems to build a live dashboard covering patient retention, no-show risk, and revenue cycle performance — without adding work for your front-office staff.

Book a Free Demo

Sound familiar?

Revenue cycle issues (denials, aging AR, underpayments) are discovered weeks after they happen.

No-shows disrupt provider schedules and nobody has visibility into who's at risk.

Patient panels grow but it's unclear which patients have quietly stopped coming back.

Reporting requires pulling data manually from multiple systems every month.

What we track for you

Built directly from your existing systems — no new software for your staff to learn.

No-show rate

Predict which upcoming appointments are at risk before they happen.

Patient retention

Track which patients haven't returned within their expected care interval.

Collections ratio

Catch revenue cycle leakage — denials, aging AR, underpayments — early.

Provider productivity

Compare visit volume and revenue per provider fairly.

Panel growth

Understand net patient growth, not just new patient count.

Appointment utilization

See where schedule gaps are costing you the most.

How it works

1

Connect

We connect to your EHR and billing systems securely, with no disruption to your existing workflow.

2

Build

We build a dashboard around your practice's specialty and how you actually track performance.

3

Predict

AI models flag no-show risk and revenue cycle issues before they show up in a monthly report.

4

Act

Your practice manager gets one dashboard to run the business from, updated automatically.

See your practice's numbers, automatically.

Book a free walkthrough. We'll show you what your dashboard would actually look like with your data.
